### Merge Data

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# combined df of all conditions

                         Sex = pw_sex,
                         Cohort = pw_cohort,
                         ExpH = pw_beh,
                         Litter = pw_litter),
                    .id = "pairwise.comp") %>%
  left_join(up_fasta,
            by = join_by(Protein == uniprot_acc))
```

### com_df_mapped - calculations df for volcano plot annotations & tally tab ano

```{r}
com_df_mapped <- com_df %>%
  
  # Filtering 
  filter(is.na(issue)) %>% # no issues  
  filter(is.numeric(adj.pvalue)) %>%  
  filter(!is.na(adj.pvalue)) %>% # fixes NA issue? 
  select(!c(...1, issue)) %>% # rm extra cols
  
  #___FOR_VOLCANO_ANNOTATION_______________
  # Make Gene Label for Sig
  mutate(sig_g_label = if_else(adj.pvalue <= .05, # text label if up to adj.pvlue 
                               gene, NA)) %>%
  # Make one for no of sig up & down for each comaprison group/label
  group_by(Label) %>%
  mutate(Direction = if_else(log2FC > 0, "Up", "Down")) %>%
  mutate(sig_no_up_lab = sum(adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0), # up
         sig_no_down_lab = sum(adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0)) %>%  #  down
  
  #___FOR_TALLY_TABLE_&_NUMBER_REPORTED______________
  # Make Tally/combined 
  mutate(sig_no = sig_no_up_lab + sig_no_down_lab, # total sig per label
         smodel_no = n(), # no.sucessful model proteins- label -since issue rm abv
         model_no = 4562, # no_modelled (no removals)
         smodel_mis_no = 4562 - n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

colnames(com_df_mapped)
```

### Sig counts summary table (34 rows)

<https://stackoverflow.com/questions/56810473/uniting-many-rows-into-one-r>

```{r}
# sig counts table 
sig_counts <- com_df_mapped %>%
  select(pairwise.comp, Label, sig_no_up_lab:smodel_mis_no) %>%
  group_by(pairwise.comp, Label) %>% # not needed?
  unique() %>%
  mutate(smodel_per = round(smodel_no/model_no*100,2), # per of successful modelled
         smodel_mis_no_per = round(smodel_mis_no/model_no*100,2), # per missing
         sig_per = round(sig_no/model_no*100,2), #
         sig_per_up = round(sig_no_up_lab/model_no*100,2), #
         sig_per_down = round(sig_no_down_lab/model_no*100,2)) #

sig_counts
colnames(sig_counts)

sig_counts$pairwise.comp <- factor(sig_counts$pairwise.comp,
                                   levels = c("Housing", "ExpH", "Cohort",
                                              "Litter", "Sex"))

```

### Sig genes summary table (34 rows)

<https://stackoverflow.com/questions/56810473/uniting-many-rows-into-one-r>

```{r}
# sig genes
sig_genes <- com_df_mapped %>%
  select(pairwise.comp, Label, gene, sig_g_label,
         Direction, log2FC, adj.pvalue) %>%
  group_by(pairwise.comp, Label) %>% # not needed?
  slice_min(adj.pvalue, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pairwise.comp, Label, Direction) %>%
  summarize(sum_genes = paste(sig_g_label[!is.na(sig_g_label)], # ignores NAs!
                              collapse = "/")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Direction, values_from = sum_genes)

```

### sig_genes_count summmary table (combined)

```{r}
sig_genes_count <- left_join(sig_counts, sig_genes,
                             by = join_by(pairwise.comp == pairwise.comp,
                                          Label == Label))

sig_genes_count$pairwise.comp <- factor(sig_genes_count$pairwise.comp,
                                   levels = c("Housing", "ExpH", "Cohort",
                                              "Litter", "Sex"))
```

### gt

<https://gt.rstudio.com/reference/tab_style.html#examples>

```{r}
sig_genes_count_gt <- sig_genes_count %>%
  select(pairwise.comp, Label,

         sig_no_up_lab, sig_per_up, Up,
         sig_no_down_lab, sig_per_down, Down,
         # smodel_no, smodel_per,
         smodel_mis_no) %>% # org cols

  gt(
    groupname_col = "pairwise.comp",
    rowname_col = "Label") %>%
  
  # gtExtras::gt_theme_nytimes() %>%
  opt_vertical_padding(scale = 0.35) %>% # vert padding
  cols_align(align = "left") %>% # align left
  
  # tab_header(title = "Preliminary Pairwise Comparisons Summary Table (MSstatsTMT)",

   tab_options(# GENERAL TABLE OPTIONS
    table.border.top.width = px(2.5), # very top of table
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2.5), # very bottom of table |not very visible
    table.border.bottom.color = "#BDBDBD",
    column_labels.border.top.width = px(2.5), # top of column labs |not very vis
    column_labels.border.top.color = "#BDBDBD", 
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(2.5), # top of column labs |not very vis
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "#BDBDBD", 
    heading.border.bottom.width = px(2.5), # more visible than above
    heading.border.bottom.color = "#BDBDBD", # more visible than above
    table.font.size = "11.5px",
     stub.font.size = "12px",
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.font.weight = "bolder"
  ) %>%
  
  cols_merge( # sig no & percentage
    columns = c(sig_no, sig_per),
    pattern = "{1} ({2}%)") %>%
  
  cols_merge( # ↑ sig 
    columns = c(sig_no_up_lab, sig_per_up),
    pattern = "{1} ({2}%)") %>%
  
  
  cols_merge( # ↓ sig 
    columns = c(sig_no_down_lab, sig_per_down),
    pattern = "{1} ({2}%)") %>%
  
    # cols_merge(# modelled 
    # columns = c(smodel_no, smodel_per),
    # pattern = "{1} ({2}%)") %>%
  
   cols_label( # relabel columns
    sig_no = "# Sig. ",
    sig_no_up_lab = "# Sig.  \u2191",
    sig_no_down_lab = "# Sig. \u2193",
    smodel_mis_no = "NA#") %>%
  
  
 tab_style( # Prevent breaking of value columns!
    style = cell_text(whitespace = "nowrap"),
    locations = list(cells_stub(),
                     cells_body(columns = c(sig_no,sig_no_up_lab,
                                            sig_no_down_lab)))) %>%
  
 tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_text(color = "#5e5e5e")),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = c(smodel_mis_no)),
      cells_column_labels(columns = c(smodel_mis_no)))) %>%
  
  
  tab_style(style = list(
    cell_text(style = "italic", size = "9.5px")),
  locations = cells_body(
    columns = c(Up, Down))) %>%
  
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      # cell_text(color = "#d33682")),
      cell_text(color = "#aa344d")),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = c(sig_no_up_lab)),
      cells_column_labels(columns = c(Up,sig_no_up_lab)))) %>%
  
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_text(color = "#344daa")),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = c(sig_no_down_lab)),
```

### Count of Significant proteins by pairwise comparison

```{r}
sig_counts_labels <- sig_counts %>%
  mutate(pairwise.comp = recode(pairwise.comp, Housing = "Hous")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Label, sig_no) %>%
  unique() 
# hcl_palettes(plot = TRUE)


count_plot <- sig_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("sig_no_up_lab", "sig_no_down_lab"),
               names_to = "direction",
               values_to = "no") %>%
  mutate(pairwise.comp = recode(pairwise.comp, Housing = "Hous")) %>%
  
  # filter(sig == 1) %>%
  ggplot() +
   geom_col(aes(x = reorder(Label, sig_no), y = no, fill = direction),
            stat = "identity", # so col sam wid
    width = .75, color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  geom_bar(aes(x = reorder(Label, sig_no), y = sig_no/2), stat = "identity",
           fill= "grey90", alpha = 0.05) + # just for mapping to anchor text!
  geom_text(data = sig_counts_labels, # needs geom_bar above to anchor
            aes(label = sig_no, x = reorder(Label, sig_no),  y = sig_no),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.7) +

  
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Direction (Log2FC)",
                    values = alpha(c("#aa344d","#2753BF"),0.4), 
                    breaks = c("sig_no_up_lab", "sig_no_down_lab"),
                    labels = c("\u2191 Upregulated", "\u2193 Downregulated")) +
  
  facet_wrap(~pairwise.comp, nrow = 1, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free_x') +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "No. of Significant Proteins (adj.pvalue ≤ .05)") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9.5, color="grey15", face = "italic"),
     legend.text = element_text(size = 9, color="grey15"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust =1, vjust = 0.5, face = "italic"),
     legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),  # space between plot & legend
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"), # size of legend key icon
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color ="grey15", size = 9.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .3),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = .3),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3),
    # panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    # panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey97", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"), # horizontal spacing - COHORT 
  )

count_plot
```

### Cohort Comparison Geom Tile Heatmap

<https://rpubs.com/Shefali/ggplot-scale-function>

- 3a vs 3b - 9 proteins ≤ adj.p 0.1

  - Wipf3, Sncg, Scpep1, Lsamp, Hdhd2, Gsr, Gja1, Atg4b, & Acadsb

- 4 vs 3a - 40 proteins ≤ adj.p 0.05

  - 2/40 overlap with 3a vs 3b ≤ adj.p 0.1 (Wipf3 & Gsr)

  - 16/40 overlap with 4 vs 3b ≤ adj.p 0.05 (Chgb, Bdh1, Dpysl3, Vcan, Decr1, Dpysl5, Nfasc, Tubb2b, Asah1, Synpo, Cd200, Lap3, Epdr1, Atg7, Lss, & Hapln1)

- 4 vs 3b - 180 proteins ≤ adj.p 0.05

  - 16/180 overlap with 4 vs 3a ≤ adj.p 0.05 (see above)

  - 5/180 overlap with 3a vs 3b ≤ adj.p 0.1 (Gja1, Acadsb, Lsamp, Sncg, & Hdhd2)

# Volcano Plots

### No Litter volcano plots

```{r}
# make new df for the geom_text bit below.
# prev had from 1 df but over plots repeately & cant index since mapped_comp huge.
sig_volcano_sum_no_litter <- com_df_mapped %>%
  filter(pairwise.comp == "Cohort") %>%
  # filter(pairwise.comp %in% c("Housing", "ExpH")) %>%
  # filter(pairwise.comp == "Sex") %>%
  dplyr::select(Label, sig_no_up_lab, sig_no_down_lab) %>%
  unique() 
  
#big_volcano_no_lit <- com_df_mapped %>%
# big_volcano_no_lit_EE <- com_df_mapped %>%
big_volcano_no_lit_C <- com_df_mapped %>%
  
  
  filter(pairwise.comp == "Cohort") %>%
  # filter(pairwise.comp %in% c("Housing", "ExpH")) %>%
  # filter(pairwise.comp == "Sex") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue), label = sig_g_label)) +
  
  
  #vline & hlines
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.1,
             color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.80, y = -log10(0.05),
           label = "adj.p <.05 \n",
           fontface = 'italic', size = 1.5, color = "grey10") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype = "dotted",
             linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.75, y = -log10(0.1),
           label = " adj.p <.1 \n",
           fontface = 'italic', size = 1.5, color = "grey30") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0),linetype = "solid",
             linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey85") +
  
  # POINTS
  ggrastr::geom_point_rast(aes(color = case_when( # conditional ass for color mapping
    adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.05", # up sig .05
    adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.05", # down sig .05
    adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.1", # up 0.1
    adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.1", # down .1
    TRUE ~ "ns" ), alpha = adj.pvalue), # catch the rest
    size = 1.7,
    raster.dpi = getOption("ggrastr.default.dpi", 330)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("firebrick", # coloring
                                "royalblue3",
                                "lightpink",
                                "lightblue3",
                                "grey80"),
                     breaks = c("up_adjp.05",
                                "down_adjp.05",
                                "up_adjp.1",
                                "down_adjp.1"),
                     labels = c("\U2191 (adj.p <.05)",
                                "\U2193 (adj.p <.05)",
                                "\U2191 (adj.p <.1)",
                                "\U2193 (adj.p <.1)")) +
  

  scale_alpha(range = c(0.55,0.05), guide = "none") + # more transparent less sig
  
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 20, size = 3, # gene text on points
                  color = "grey10",  segment.size	= 0.2,
                  segment.alpha = 0.5, min.segment.length = 0.5) + 

               
  
  # NUM SIG UP & DOWN! | use sep df, overwise overplots
  geom_text(data = sig_volcano_sum_no_litter, # up 
            aes(label = paste0(sig_no_up_lab, " \U2191")),
            # x = 1.78, y = 9.7, size = 4, color = "firebrick") +  # sex
            # x = 1.8, y = 4.35, size = 4.2, color = "firebrick") + # Hous & ExpH
            x = 1.8, y = 6.65, size = 4.2, color = "firebrick") + # Hous & ExpH
  
  geom_text(data = sig_volcano_sum_no_litter, # down
            aes(label = paste0(sig_no_down_lab, " \U2193")),
            # x = -1.78, y = 9.7, size = 4, color = "royalblue3") +  # sex
            # x = -1.8, y = 4.35, size = 4.2, color = "royalblue3") + # Hous & ExpH
             x = -1.8, y = 6.65, size = 4.2, color = "royalblue3") + # cohort
  

  xlim(-2,2) +
  # ylim(0,10) + # sex
  # ylim(0,4.5) + # Housing & ExpH
  # ylim(0,7.6) + # Cohort
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,8,2.5)) + # cohort
  facet_wrap(~Label, ncol = 3) + 
  facet_wrap(~Label, ncol = 3) + 
  labs(x = "log2FC",
       y = "-Log10(adj.p value)",
       color = "Protein Regulation") +

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.1,
             color = "grey30") +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype = "dotted",
             linewidth = 0.1, color = "grey50") +

  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0),linetype = "solid",
             linewidth = 0.1, color = "grey80") +
  
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1, byrow=TRUE)) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # legend.position = "none", # sex & Housing/ExpH
    legend.position = "bottom", # cohort
    axis.title = element_text(color = "grey10", size = 9.5),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "grey10", size = 9.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey10"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey97", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm"), # vert spacing
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm"), # horizontal spacing - COHORT 
    legend.margin = margin(-5,0,0,0),  # space between plot & legend
    legend.key.size = unit(0.7, "cm"), # size of legend key icon
  )

big_volcano_no_lit_C
```

```{r}
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 20, size = 3, # gene text on points
                  color = "grey10",  segment.size	= 0.2,
```

## Venny - Cohort Comp (sp) to Age comp (1pspg)

<https://venn.bio-spring.top/intro>

```{r}
load("input/MSstatsTMT/comp/2025_12_31_1pspg_v3.2.2_t1_EExAge_mapped_comp.rda")

AgeEE_1pspg <- mapped_comp_v3.2.2_EExAge_t1
```

```{r}
Age_1pspg <- AgeEE_1pspg %>%
  filter(Label %in% c("A_YNG_vs_OLD", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_EE_OLD",
                      "HxA_SH_YNG_vs_SH_OLD")) %>%
  select(Protein:adj.pvalue, gene,description,database)

cohort_sp <- com_df_mapped %>%
  filter(pairwise.comp == "Cohort") %>%
  select(Protein:adj.pvalue, gene,description,database)

Age_cohort_merged <- bind_rows(list( Age = Age_1pspg, Cohort = cohort_sp),
                               .id = "analysis")
```

```{r}
AC_lists <- Age_cohort_merged %>%
  filter(adj.pvalue <= 0.05) %>% # filter by sig
  split(.$Label) %>% # split by label (comparison)
  purrr::map(~pull(., gene)) # map (pull each list of genes from each) -> 5 lists $
```

```{r}
#ggvenn::ggvenn(AC_lists)
# #bfbbd5
ggvenn::ggvenn(AC_lists[-c(4,5)],
               stroke_alpha = 0.7,
               fill_alpha = 0.7,
               stroke_size = 0.5,
               set_name_size = 3.5,
               text_size = 3.2,
               fill_color = c('#ccbbd5', '#bbc4d5', '#B0ABCB'))
```
